notes.title: A Note from the Developers: Something Has Surfaced
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hello, detectives.[/p][p][/p][p]While performing routine maintenance on the archives for [i]Gloomy Clues[/i], our team stumbled upon something unexpected. Something that doesn't quite fit.[/p][p]Tucked away in a forgotten folder, we found a piece of concept art we have no memory of creating. It could be nothing, or it could be everything. It feels like a missed clue, a loose thread on a case we all thought was closed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186157/4e45c3bbe8edab5dabd236098e84d6b60d402fd9.png"][/img][/p][p]We're not sure what it means or where it will lead, but one thing is clear: the story might not be over.[/p][p]We believe the best way to investigate this is out in the open. We're going to start pulling on this thread on our social media, sharing each discovery as we make it. If you felt the call of the mystery the first time, we invite you to join this new investigation from the very beginning.[/p][p]Follow the clues with us on our official X (Twitter) account: [/p][p][url="https://x.com/PixelParadiseOU"]https://x.com/PixelParadiseOU[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.
The investigation is reopened.[/p][p]- The Pixel Paradise Team[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p]
